t: Two shifts, and where they overlap
a: يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ
p: Yataʿāqabūna fīkum malāʾikatun bi-l-layli wa malāʾikatun bi-n-nahār, wa yajtamiʿūna fī ṣalāti-l-fajri wa ṣalāti-l-ʿaṣr
m: Angels take turns among you, some by night and some by day, and they come together at the dawn prayer and the afternoon prayer.
